title: Principles keep work moving and consistent; decisions one at a time undermine integrity (2026-10-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Take all clear principle based decisions and add them. 

The point of principles is to keep moving things forward and to maintain consistency. Decisions taken one at a time undermine integrity.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-27; recorded verbatim. Context: Claude Code had reviewed the 24 open needs-input issues and found 15 answerable from existing principles and rulings, 6 not questions, and 3 real questions.
